name: @caisson/migrate
description: The base migration assembler + runner (ADR-0070/0090): reads each selected package's on-disk migrations/NNNN_*.sql, merges them via the kernel into ONE renumbered sequence + single schema_version ledger, emits the generated-app file set, and applies the sequence forward-only through an injected runner port. Owned here so @caisson/cli and @caisson/compliance import it, never copy it.
